units.translation: See these blows of the heart, from where
uttering pains that sting the heart in return
Who, nourishing his heart in nothing in the light (in fear Auratus) – ?
and in their heart carrying a vote
sending forth a venomous drop of the heart, requiting grief
hear me with a kindly heart
I heard a word that lashes (scourges Auratus) the heart
and my dark-hued heart leaps
and neighboring cares of the heart kindle terror
and a heart unaccustomed to tears
by force of the heart to obtain marriage
and the heart kicks the mind with fear
with raging heart
of the heart
with brightness, with uprightness of mind
and with dark-hued wave it leaps
heart
heart
heart
in the heart
heart-biting
biting the heart
Thus Abreschius for καρδίᾳ δηκτόν [bitten in the heart].
and you strengthen for me a power equal in soul, heart-biting, from women
bitten in the heart
Carians or Europa
was the title of a play of Aeschylus
fruitful
fruitful
of fruitful summer
fruit
fruit
Improperly, outcome, effect
where see the note
and all kinds of fruit falling to the ground
of evil company — the fruit is not to be gathered
the fruit of the pale olive
do not cast to the ground the fruit of a vain tongue
and the fruit of the earth and the flowing abundance of flocks
but the fruit of the papyrus does not prevail over the ear of corn
if there will be fruit for the oracles of Loxias
fruitful, bringing fruit to perfection
fertile, fruitful
thus Stanley for καρποτελεῖ [fruitful]
and may Zeus bring to fulfillment the land with fruit in due season
fruitful
to bear fruit
I bear fruit
Middle form καρπόομαι I possess something from which fruit can be gathered, I enjoy
for hybris, flowering, bore fruit, a crop of ruin
he will reap as much land as the broad-flowing Nile irrigates
the race of the Pelasgians enjoys this land
Libya, the name of a very great land, enjoying it
reaping a deep furrow through the mind
he himself may reap the error of his mind
there is no way I could say false things to be enjoyed by friends for a long time
I enjoy, I reap the fruits of
fruit, produce
fruit
Cypris proclaims fruits dripping
very, indeed, certainly
very, indeed, certainly
Butler conjectured that κάρτα [very] should be restored for καλά [beautiful things].
and he is very much a native
and Justice of kindred blood strongly commands him
and very aptly named, I mean Polyneices
since the god strongly urges the matter
and very truly the revered Erinys of father Oedipus has fulfilled
and they are very much of the same blood
such things he said, and very much from a cheerful mind
how very clearly you have shown me evils
how very much you have blamed the mind of a young girl
or indeed to be lifted up by a woman's heart
you were very unmusically written
seeming to be very well-disposed to me
in embroidered robes he seems to me to walk very much
but he was a wrestler, breathing very much favor upon me
or indeed you have been very much deceived in hearing my oracles
and indeed this one is very much like a bird to look at
very much resembling us to look at
a house seeming now very much to have fallen
or indeed the fear from dreams is a very true prophet
and when he comes, the people honor him greatly
and may you be very truly named the Escort
or indeed very dishonored – the pledges of Zeus
for I know that you are very much pondering these things
